violation_type.title: An administrative penalty not assessed against your center during previous two years while your director was serving in that role (26 TAC §746.1317(a)(6)(C))

violation_type.typical_finding: During a review of the staff trainings there were trainings certificates with the director's name on it. The director was listed as the trainer.
